description: First jaxFMM GPU campaign on the FP32 point-dipole lattice with identical point targets. Nominal orders do not match in accuracy (KIFMM p=6 carries 152 equivalent charges per box, dip-fmm order 6 carries 49 spherical coefficients), so every arm runs at every size and the comparison is made at achieved accuracy: jaxFMM KIFMM p=4/6/8 against dip-fmm orders 6 and 10. The dip-fmm prism-to-prism arm is the finite-target companion and is never part of a point-target ratio.
